name: com.cssalt.smmarts-sdk-package
description: The SMMARTS (System of Modular Mixed & Augmented Reality Tracking Simulators) SDK is a software development kit designed for creating and customizing medical simulation environments using Unity, Arduino, and NDI tracking systems. It provides tools and templates for building realistic and interactive simulations, including ultrasound probes, interventional tools, camera controllers, means to import custom anatomy.
